text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. The school garden seemed rather lively,
so I went over to take a look...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwomaaaan!!
Did you spend your own pocket money again?!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What's with that huge plantation over there?!
What are you planning to do with it~?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on! Wait, wait, Tazuna!!
There's a very, very deep and valid reason for this, you see?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I will listen, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Compassion!
With the hosting of the URA Finals, I decided we needed something to liven up the venue!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
When you think of the racetrack, you think of racetrack gourmet!
Enjoying delicious food while watching the races is unbeatable!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However, it can't just be delicious food; it needs a distinct hook that will get people talking!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! I resolved to build a massive farm
and cultivate 'Tracen Brand Carrots'!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...I understand your feelings very well, Chairwoman.
Well, I can always understand just your feelings, at least.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Still!! The way you're doing it!! That's the real problem hereeee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Gyaa! Tazuna!
Mercy! Have mercyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...*ahem*.
Trainer, you're here."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
F-Forgive me...
I've shown you an unsightly side of myself...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Digression aside!
You seem to be working hard, my friend!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However—hrmm, looks like there's still room for improvement.
Her fan count seems to have plateaued.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However! I commend your hard work!!
Continue to enter races proactively and win over more fans!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Going smoothly! You're delivering solid results
and gaining fans rapidly!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I want you to aim for even greater heights
and set your sights on running
in the URA Finals!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astounding! A performance that far exceeds all imagination!
Your fan count is growing at a phenomenal rate too!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Expectations are already high for your entry in the URA Finals. Keep up this momentum, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Right, speaking of working hard—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...It is.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer Kiryuin! And Meek too!
What a coincidence! We were just talking about you two!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, of course,
but your growth is truly remarkable as well! Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Chairwoman Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Trainer <username>……
we've made up our minds.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To worry together, to walk together,
and to aim for the pinnacle as two—that is my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...I will win. ...I will prove it.
...That my Trainer is amazing."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I too will strive harder than ever to bring Bitter Glasse the greatest honor.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Conquering the 'URA Finals.'
...That is the goal for the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ......Hooray, hooray, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. So this is where everyone was.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hello. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Otonashi-kun!
Of course, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Actually, there is something I would like to show you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi smiled and showed me
the online article about the URA Finals, along with—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It was a flood of comments sent in by countless fans, expressing all their hopes and expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Ooooohh!!
This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone's hard work,
the "URA Finals" is generating an incredible amount of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Inspiring...!!
The stage is finally being set...!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely!!
Gonna make the URA Finals a huge success!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stage built for every Umamusume to shine,
the "URA Finals"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My excitement for the event grew and grew...!
